explanation: Its patterns are painted with fermented mud on cloth dyed first in a leaf bath rich in tannin. In the Bamana language, bogolan means made with mud.

claims.text: Bogolanfini from Mali is known in English as mud cloth.
Kente, bark cloth and raffia cloth are different textiles from bogolanfini.
Bogolanfini patterns are painted with fermented mud on cotton that has been dyed beforehand in a tannin-rich leaf bath.
In the Bamana (Bambara) language, bogolan means made with mud.
